title: Yes-or-No Object · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Yes-or-No Object · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: The lead secretly chooses a familiar object in the room. The other players ask only yes-or-no questions until they identify the object. The group identifies the object within ten questions. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Yes-or-No Object, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group identifies the object within ten questions.
recall.why: The group identifies the object within ten questions.
